problem: Learn multimodal bimanual manipulation policies despite scarce target dual-arm data and heterogeneous action spaces across source robots.
contribution: RDT-1B is a diffusion transformer with physically labelled unified action slots, multimodal conditioning and large multi-robot pretraining followed by target bimanual finetuning.
algorithm: Map physical quantities into a padded unified vector; encode proprioception/actions/frequency with Fourier-feature MLPs and frozen SigLIP/T5-XXL conditions. Train direct clean-action denoising; alternate image/text cross-attention and mask modalities to reduce shortcuts.
observations: Proprioception, control frequency, two time steps of exterior/left-wrist/right-wrist images and language. This is substantially richer than one overview camera and command estimates.
actions: Continuous multimodal action chunks, interpreted through physical slots and robot-specific masks rather than copying arbitrary joint indices across robots.
embodiment_and_data: 46datasets, over1Mtrajectories/21TB pretraining; target ALOHA finetuning over6Ktrajectories,300tasks,100objects and15rooms. One/five-shot skill subsets sit within this much larger pretrained/finetuned context.
experiments: Seven physical ALOHA tasks covering objects/scenes, instruction-following, dexterity and few-shot skills. Handover/folding/robot-dog each25trials; wash/pour groups24trials; instruction variants8each. Partial stages and total task completion are separately tabulated.
baselines: ACT, OpenVLA, Octo and RDT from scratch; ACT is explicitly not language-conditioned and absent from instruction-following comparisons. Architecture/data ablations investigate pretraining and model size.

quantitative_result.value: Five-demo handover: switch-hand stage56%, total task40% over25trials; scratch total16%, ACT0%, Octo0%, OpenVLA0%. Do not relabel56%intermediate completion as full handover success. One-demo fold-shorts total68% over25trials.
quantitative_result.location: PDF p9 denominator/setup and p10 Table3

limitations: Requires substantial pretraining and target data; reported few-shot labels are task-specific demonstration counts, not total learning from one/five trajectories. Physical task failures remain frequent and a unified physical action schema does not establish calibration/contact equivalence.
code_and_license: Paper reports released code, models and target datasets; exact source revision and independent code/model/data-license verification were not performed here. No RDT execution is claimed.
hardware_adaptation: Reuse explicit physical-quantity masks and frequency metadata as design context. A1TBdisk cannot hold its entire21TBsource corpus; selective licensed datasets and compact tested policies are necessary. Learned ALOHA handover does not validate Explorer's protocol FSM or release sensing.
